overview_description.description: Motive develops technology that connects and automates physical operations for businesses across various industries. The company provides a platform that combines telematics, fleet management, compliance tools, equipment monitoring, and AI-powered safety solutions. Its products help companies track vehicles, monitor driver behavior, automate workflows, and ensure regulatory compliance through real-time data and analytics. Motive also offers integrated solutions for spend management and maintenance, enabling businesses to control costs and improve operational efficiency. The platform supports diverse sectors including trucking, construction, oil and gas, and agriculture by centralizing data and enabling actionable insights. Through automation and visibility, Motive helps organizations optimize asset utilization and enhance decision-making in day-to-day operations.

about_short_description.short_description: Motive is a fleet management and driver safety platform that helps improve the safety, productivity, and profitability of fleet operations.

product.name: Motive Integrated Operations Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that combines fleet safety, vehicle and equipment monitoring, workforce administration, and fleet-related spending in one system.

product.name: Driver Safety
product.description: An AI-based driver safety solution that uses vehicle cameras, real-time alerts, event detection, and coaching tools to identify and reduce risky driving behavior.

product.name: Fleet Management
product.description: A fleet operations solution that provides vehicle location, usage, health, telematics, compliance, maintenance, dispatch, and workflow-management capabilities.

product.name: Equipment Monitoring
product.description: A connected asset-monitoring solution for tracking the location, utilization, operating status, and condition of trailers, machinery, and other fleet equipment.

product.name: Spend Management
product.description: A fleet spending solution centered on the Motive Card, with controls and transaction data for managing fuel and other fleet-related expenses.

product.name: Workforce Management
product.description: A workforce administration solution for managing driver qualifications, time records, training, coaching, documents, and related employee information.
